human.name: Human
human.description: Adaptable and numerous. Welcome in the Golden Kingdoms, tolerated most places.

orc.name: Orc
orc.description: Hard clans of the contested borderlands.

draconic.name: Draconic
draconic.description: Scaled bloodlines said to descend from the old wyrms.

demonkin.name: Demonkin
demonkin.description: Marked by the Ashen Wastes. Feared almost everywhere.

celestial.name: Celestial
celestial.description: Touched by something above the sky. Rare and distrusted by the dark powers.
